module cancel_deadline(input clk,rst_n,req,cancel,finish,output reg busy,accepted,completed,cancelled,expired);
reg [1:0] remaining;
always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
 if(!rst_n) begin busy<=0;remaining<=0;accepted<=0;completed<=0;cancelled<=0;expired<=0;end
 else begin
  accepted<=0;completed<=0;cancelled<=0;expired<=0;
  if(!busy) begin if(req) begin busy<=1;remaining<=3;accepted<=1;end end
  else if(cancel) begin busy<=0;remaining<=0;cancelled<=1;end
  else if(finish) begin busy<=0;remaining<=0;completed<=1;end
  else if(remaining==1) begin busy<=0;remaining<=0;expired<=1;end
  else remaining<=remaining-1'b1;
 end
end
endmodule
